DomainData.MainInfoText: Marka aad booqato websayt kasta, waxa laga yaabaa in lagu kaydiyo ama dib looga helo macluumaadka borowsarkaaga, badanaa isagoo ah nooca kukiyada. Macluumaadkani waxa laga yaabaa inay ku saabsan yihiin adiga, xulashadaada, qalabkaaga ama loo isticmaalo si looga dhigo boggayaga interneetka inuu u shaqeeyo sida aad ka rajaynayso. Macluumaadku si toos ah kuuma sheegayo, laakiin waxa uu ku siin karaa khibrad websayt oo wax laga baddeli karo. Waxa aad dooran kartaa inaanad oggolaan qaar kamid ah kukiyada. Tuuji qaybta kale ee madaxyada si aad u oggaato in badan aanad u baddesho habaynta asalka ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waa inaad ogaataa in xanibida noocyo kamid ah kukiyada ay saamayn karaan khibradaada bogga interneetka iyo adeegyada aan awoodno inaan bixino.
DomainData.AlertNoticeText: Waxa aan u isticmaalnaa kukiyadaka si ay inoogu oggolaato boggayaga interneetka si fiican ugu shaqeeya, aynu wax ka baddelno waxyaalaha kujira iyo xayaysiiska, inaan bixino muuqaalada baraha bulshada aanan falanqayno taraafikayaga. Sidoo kale waxa aan macluumaadka ku saabsan isticmaalkaaga boggayaga interneetka la wadaagnaa baraha bulshada, xayaysiiska iyo falanqaynta ka qaybqaatayaasha.Cookie Notice
DomainData.CookieListDescription: Kukiga waa qayb yar oo xog ah (fayl qoraal ah) kaasi oo websaytku – marka uu booqdo isticmaale – uu waydiiyo borowsarkaaga inuu ku kaydiyo qalabkaaga si uu u xasuusto macluumaadka adiga kugu saabsan, sida luuqadaada aad xulatay ama macluumaadka galitaanka. Kukiyadaas waxaa hagaajiyay anaga waxana loogu yeedhaa qaybta koowaad ee kukiyada. Sidoo kale waxa aan isticmaalnaa kukiyada qaybta saddexaad – kuwaasi oo ah kukiyo ka socdo dhoomayn kaasi oo ka duwan dhoomaynka websaytka aad booqanayso – waxaana loogu talagalay xayaysiiskayaga iyo dedaaladayada suuq-gaynta. Si aad usii cayiman, waxa aanu u isticmaalnaa kukiyada iyo tiknoolijayado kale ujeedooyinkan soo socda:

Groups.GroupDescription: Kukiyadani waxa ay lagama maarmaan u yihiin websaytku inuu shaqeeyo lamana damin karo iyadoo la isticmaalaya sistamkayaga. Kaliya waxa lagu buuxiyaa jawaab ficilada aad adigu samaysay taasi oo ah inta codsi ee adeegyada, sida ku buuxinta xulshada qarsoodigaaga, galitaanka ama buuxinta foomamka. Waxa aad ka dhigi kartaa borowsarkaaga inuu xanibo ama uu digniin ka bixiyo kukiyadani, laakiin qaybo kamid ah bogga interneetka waxa laga yaabaa inaanay shaqayn.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: AWSALB
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with the Amazon Web Services Elastic Load Balancing functionality for routing client request on the server.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: OptanonConsent
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie is set by the cookie compliance solution from OneTrust. It stores information about the categories of cookies the site uses and whether visitors have given or withdrawn consent for the use of each category. This enables site owners to prevent cookies in each category from being set in the users browser, when consent is not given. The cookie has a normal lifespan of one year, so that returning visitors to the site will have their preferences remembered. It contains no information that can identify the site visitor.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: AWSALBCORS
FirstPartyCookies.description: This AWS cookie is used for load balancing.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: OptanonAlertBoxClosed
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie is set by websites using certain versions of the cookie law compliance solution from OneTrust.  It is set after visitors have seen a cookie information notice and in some cases only when they actively close the notice down.  It enables the website not to show the message more than once to a user.  The cookie has a one year lifespan and contains no personal information.

Waxa ay naga caawiyaan inaan ogaano boggaga leh caanimada ugu badan iyo kuwo ugu yar iyo inaan aragno sida ay booqdayaashu u dhaqaaqaan gudaha boggayaga interneetka. Dhammaan macluumaadka kukiyadani ay ururiyaan waa la isku duubayaa sidaa darteedna waxay noqonayaa kuwa qarsoodi ah. Haddii aadan oggolaan kukiyadani, ma oggaan karno marka aad booqatay boggayaga interneetka.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: _gid
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with Google Universal Analytics. This appears to be a new cookie and as of Spring 2017 no information is available from Google.  It appears to store and update a unique value for each page visited._gid

FirstPartyCookies.Name: _gat
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with Google Universal Analytics, according to documentation it is used to throttle the request rate - limiting the collection of data on high traffic sites. It expires after 10 minutes.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: _ga
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with Google Universal Analytics - which is a significant update to Google's more commonly used analytics service. This cookie is used to distinguish unique users by assigning a randomly generated number as a client identifier. It is included in each page request in a site and used to calculate visitor, session and campaign data for the sites analytics reports.  By default it is set to expire after 2 years, although this is customisable by website owners.

FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie is associated with Google Universal Analytics and is used to analyze how visitors use the site.
